question: Is g18 ready because it has three rows, and what must happen before switching from g17?

criteria.instruction: No. s12 requires a/1/ha,b/3/hb,c/2/hc under pB. a is correct, b has wrong pA profile and c is stale c/1/hc-old. Rebuild/correct privately, verify exact source-version/chunk bindings and homogeneous pB coverage, perform matched-profile validation and obtain review before switching. Retain g17 with pA for a documented compatible rollback.
Join the staged rows and s12 manifest with V8 and migration review. Three physical rows do not establish complete eligible-source coverage.
Do not relabel old vectors, declare g18 active or approved, or substitute stale source content without explicit review.
